solves.reasoning: A: 'wise decisions'는 유능함의 긍정 자질 → wise. B: 'too competent make us ___'+unapproachable/make us look bad → uncomfortable. C: 'like people more if they ___ evidence of fallibility'+screwed up 예시 → reveal
A: 자질 나열 → smartness. B: 'unapproachable, ___, superhuman' 부정 나열 → distant. C: 인상적 인물 예시 → brilliant mathematician
A: 'It would seem ___ that 유능→호감' → obvious. B: 'If this were ___' 가정 → true. C: 'superb athlete' 재능 예시 → superb
①foolish decisions는 유능함 자질과 반대(원래 wise). ②chance ③knows ④comparison은 문맥 적절 → ①
①cluster ②possibility ③distant 적절. ④hide는 'like people more if they ___ evidence' 흐름과 반대(원래 reveal) → ④
①qualities ③superhuman ④fallibility 적절. ②relaxed는 'too competent make us ___'+부정 흐름과 반대(원래 uncomfortable) → ②
'a cluster of ___ : smartness, ability, wise decisions' 긍정 특성 나열 → qualities
'One ___ is that ~'로 추측을 여는 자리, 뒤가 may seem → possibility
'reveal some evidence of ___'+뒤 예시 '가끔 실수하면 더 호감' → 약점 fallibility
competent(유능한)의 유의어 → capable
uncomfortable(불편한)의 유의어 → uneasy
superb(훌륭한)의 유의어 → excellent
wise(현명한)의 반의어 → foolish (clever/smart는 유의어 함정)
distant(거리감 있는)의 반의어 → close (far/remote는 유의어 함정)
(A) we will like that person=좋아하다, (B) sings like a musician=~처럼
'ability to do something successfully or efficiently'=유능함 → competence
'by ___ (compare)': 전치사 by 뒤 명사 자리 → comparison
'like him or her ___ (good)': like ~ better 비교급 → better
'But it ___'로 앞의 이점 서술을 뒤집고 예외 설명이 이어짐 → doesn't always work this way
'although we like competent people, ___'+뒤 unapproachable/superhuman/make us look bad → those who are too competent make us uncomfortable
